title: Pen display got mis-recorgnized as touchscreen while touchscreen optimizes cannot be disabled
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in 4.7 dev5. not reproducible in 4.7 dev4. I guess it's problem related to the recently merged touchscreen optimize pr. ### System information Godot v4.7.dev (caf16709a) - Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie) 13 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (nvidia) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10875H CPU @ 2.30GHz (16 threads) - 39.08 GiB memory ### Issue description after updated from Godot 4.7 dev4 to dev5, godot would recorgnize my screen as "touchscreen", which causes "drag a folder to another folder" becomes impossible since godot treats my drag as "scrolling the FileSystem panel". ### Steps to reproduce Pen display required. I guess same problem would accur on those laptop with touchscreen. I have a Huion Kamvas 22 Plus pen display as my screen and drawing tool. unselect "Enable Touchscreen Optimization" didn't works. my pc still got recorgnized as "Touchscreen". the 3D workspace even shows a 3d touchscreen controller, which I only see them on tablet before. while plugged out my pen display (or downgrade to 4.7 dev4), my pc finally got recorgnized as desktop, not touchscreen anymore. the drag and drop becomes available again, every thing works fine again. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
